mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monthly_goals ( user_id, goal_month, title, target_category, reduction_ratio, baseline_amount, monthly_save, status, actual_saved ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{goalMonth}, #{title}, #{targetCategory}, #{reductionRatio}, #{baselineAmount}, #{monthlySave}, 'active', NULL ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, goal_month) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, target_category = EXCLUDED.target_category, reduction_ratio = EXCLUDED.reduction_ratio, baseline_amount = EXCLUDED.baseline_amount, monthly_save = EXCLUDED.monthly_save, status = 'active', actual_saved = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

MERGE INTO monthly_goals ( user_id, goal_month, title, target_category, reduction_ratio, baseline_amount, monthly_save, status, actual_saved, updated_at ) KEY (user_id, goal_month) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{goalMonth}, #{title}, #{targetCategory}, #{reductionRatio}, #{baselineAmount}, #{monthlySave}, 'active', NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, goal_month, title, target_category, reduction_ratio, baseline_amount, monthly_save, status, actual_saved, CAST(created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at, CAST(updated_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS updated_at FROM monthly_goals WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND goal_month = #{goalMonth}
